== NAME ==
hwLabel - multi-line GUI text display

== INHERITS FROM ==
* [[hwGUI]]

== PROPERTIES ==
| Label | 0S | The text to display
| Font | 0O | The font to use for display
| FontHeight | 1I | The character height, in pixels
| Color | 3F | Color of the characters
| BackgroundColor | 4F | Background color of bounding box
| BorderColor | 4F | Border color of the bounding box
| Texture | 0O | Texture to use as background image of label

== DEFAULTS ==
| Color | {1,1,1}
| BackgroundColor | {0,0,0,0}
| BorderColor | {0,0,0,0}
| FontHeight |  12

== DESCRIPTION ==
The hwLabel class may be used to put a label at a given position on
the screen.  It inherits the typical [[hwGUI]] positioning properties
and rules.  Note that the label text may be multi-line, separated by
newline '\n' characters.

== C EXAMPLE ==
{{{
    hwObject myLabel;

    myLabel = hwLabel->create( hwLabel );
    HW_MODIFY_1I( myLabel, hwStrPosX, 100 );
    HW_MODIFY_1I( myLabel, hwStrPosY, 100 );
    HW_MODIFY_1I( myLabel, hwStrWidth, 0 );
    HW_MODIFY_1I( myLabel, hwStrHeight, 0 );
    myLabel->modify( myLabel, hwStrLabel, HW_TYPE_STRING, "Two\nLines" );
}}}

== OBJECT FILE EXAMPLE ==
{{{
    hwLabel myLabel {
        PosX = 100  PosY = 100
        Width = 0   Height = 0
        Label = "Two\nLines"
    }
}}}
